_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and add your OpenRouter key. Set a per-key spend limit in OpenRouter and rotate the key after the prank.
_provider: OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible). base_url + model IDs are OpenRouter's, not Anthropic's.
_model_help: Pick from https://openrouter.ai/models . For the real prank, a Claude model gives the best DDLC roleplay. Sonnet 5 is the current best-and-cheapest. To TEST at $0 balance, use a ':free' model (see _free_options). Note: older slugs like anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet are no longer served ('No endpoints found').
